items.rationale: All major domain failure modes mitigated.

items.rationale: Correctness design is sound; expected output shows passing results (though execution not verified in trace, the static design is correct).

downstream_risks: Final reduction-of-warp-sums branch nests `if (threadIdx.x == 0)` inside `if (warp_id == 0)`, which works but could be confused with shfl across inactive lanes; behavior is correct since warp 0 lanes all hold valid warp_sum from shared_sums (with zero default for lanes >= num_warps).
